tool_schemas.name: search_tako
tool_schemas.description: Searches within the specified workspace for prior tool runs, datasets, and uploaded files matching the provided query string, returning up to `limit` results and a continuation `cursor` when more results are available (omit `cursor` to start from the first page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id`/`query` are missing or malformed, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to access the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace or API key has exceeded allowed search/audit query limits.

query.description: Search query string to find prior tool runs, datasets, or files in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the search (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous search_tako response.

tool_schemas.name: upload_file_to_visualize
tool_schemas.description: Uploads a base64-encoded file to the specified workspace and returns a `file_id` that can be used with `visualize_file`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id`, `filename`, or `file_base64` are missing/invalid, if `file_base64` cannot be decoded, or if the provided `content_type` is invalid. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot write to the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if storage or upload limits for the workspace/API key are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to store the uploaded file under (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

filename.description: Original filename to record for the upload.

content_type.description: MIME content type of the uploaded file (e.g., text/csv, application/pdf).

tool_schemas.name: visualize_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates a visualization artifact for an uploaded file in the given workspace and returns the visualization in the requested `visualization_kind` (default server behavior applies when omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id`/`file_id` are malformed or if `visualization_kind` is not one of the supported values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the workspace/file, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or file does not exist (or the file is not owned by the workspace), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if visualization/compute limits are exceeded for the workspace/API key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the file (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

file_id.description: Uploaded file ULID returned from upload_file_to_visualize (format: tako_file_01H8...).

tool_schemas.name: visualize_dataset
tool_schemas.description: Stores/associates the provided structured dataset with the workspace, runs visualization, and returns the visualization in the requested `visualization_kind`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `format` is not `tako_data_format_json`, if `payload_json` does not conform to the Tako Data Format schema, or if required fields are missing/malformed. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot write to the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if dataset size, storage, or visualization/compute limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to store/associate the dataset and tool run (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

payload_json.description: Dataset payload encoded in Tako Data Format JSON.

tool_schemas.name: get_tako_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity derived from the presented API key, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the API key is missing, invalid, or revoked.

api_key.description: Tako API key presented by the caller (format: tako_key_...).

tool_schemas.name: list_uploaded_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists uploaded files in a workspace with optional status filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns file records ordered by newest first. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination or filters.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list files for (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_uploaded_files response.

tool_schemas.name: get_uploaded_file
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single uploaded file by id within the given workspace. Returns the uploaded_files record (metadata only; does not return raw bytes). Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the workspace/file, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist in the workspace, and VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the file (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

tool_schemas.name: update_uploaded_file
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an uploaded file, including allowed lifecycle transitions (e.g., marking scan results) and soft-deletion. Returns the updated uploaded_files record. Refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, cross-workspace access, or attempts to modify immutable storage fields. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot write to the workspace/file, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the file (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

status.description: New status to set. Must follow the uploaded_files lifecycle transition rules.

error_message.description: Optional error details when transitioning to status='failed'.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool invocation audit records (tool_runs) in a workspace, optionally filtered by tool_name, status, and related file/dataset ids. Returns run records ordered by newest first. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list runs for (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

uploaded_file_id.description: Optional filter to runs associated to an uploaded file (format: tako_file_01H8...).

dataset_id.description: Optional filter to runs associated to a dataset (format: tako_ds_01H8...).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_tool_runs response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_tool_run
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-progress tool run in the workspace by transitioning its status to 'cancelled' when allowed (queued -> cancelled or running -> cancelled). Returns the updated tool_runs record. Refuses cancellation of terminal runs (succeeded/failed/cancelled) and invalid transitions. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the workspace/run, NOT_FOUND if the run does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that owns the run (format: tako_ws_01H8...).

tool_run_id.description: Tool run ULID to cancel (format: tako_run_01H8...).

metadata.name: Tako
metadata.description: This backend stores uploaded files and structured datasets submitted for visualization, along with the resulting visualization artifacts. It also tracks user/workspace access via API keys and keeps an audit trail of tool invocations (search and visualization) for troubleshooting, quotas, and billing
